libs.note: BH-9025. The time bound of archie_repo_activity_block, the `## Repo activity` block of the orchestrator's fresh-turn prompt (bin/orchestrate.sh compose_v2_prompt) and of Archie's check tick (bin/archie.sh). One reader per repo, in parallel. Applied by the block through lib_env_apply orchestrate in a subshell; the code literals are the documented fallback.

knobs.note: Per-call timeout of every GitHub read a repo reader makes (passed down as GH_REST_TIMEOUT_S). A read past it prints `UNREADABLE <endpoint> HTTP 000 (timeout)` and the block says `<repo> UNREADABLE timed out after <n>s`. Code fallback 5 in bin/lib/archie-repo-activity.sh; outside 1..60 is the default.

Wall-time budget of the whole block. Past it the block prints what it has, `<repo> UNREADABLE not finished in <n>s` per repo still reading, and `(not finished in <n>s: <repos>)`. Code fallback 10 in bin/lib/archie-repo-activity.sh; outside 1..120 is the default.
